title: payment-svc OOMKilled — JVM heap exhausted (4 restarts in 30min)
description: payment-svc pod OOMKilled at 02:29Z. JVM heap -Xmx4g hit 100% utilization. GC overhead exceeded. SessionCache grew to 2.1M entries with no eviction policy. Pod restarted 4 times. Recommend: increase heap to -Xmx6g and add LRU eviction to SessionCache.

title: Add memory utilization alerts and heap dump on OOM for payment-svc
description: No alerting existed for JVM heap > 80%. Add Prometheus alert for jvm_memory_used_bytes > 80% of max. Configure -XX:+HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError so future OOMs leave a heap dump for analysis. Also add SessionCache.size() metric.
